scope: Original hydraulic model1 Snow/Frost numerical heat2, primary SWDRA1/SWDIVD1, SWBOTB5 or8, water/CDE, explicit or fitted implicit conductivity, hysteresis2, initialization2, original dense daily output and SWRES1. No boundary-file indirection.
design: A distinct bounded selector delegates all physical processes to the current qualified Frost and original lower-boundary implementations. Existing nonselected dispatch remains literal. Distinct explicit/implicit water/CDE native codecs identify this composition. The existing 96-byte implicit rate carry stores and validates the actual SWBOTB5/8 domain instead of writing a false bottom6 witness. Default bottom6 generated provider remains byte-exact.
invariants: Unchanged 1e-10 water/CDE guards, original boundary fluxes, accepted trial state, rollback, exact cold native/user output, and existing unselected process source. No flux replacement, fallback, mass correction or tolerance change.

qualification_selection.first: Real public input selection, generated native bottom witnesses, exact nonselected source inverse, then smallest actual O0/O2 build and native process probe.
qualification_selection.integrated: Eight new boundary5/8 x water/CDE x explicit/implicit contexts per optimization and platform, selected full35 and exact own cold/native/transaction/refusal checks; inherit parent periods only through exact actual dependency/source evidence.
qualification_selection.original_reference_limit: Existing original Windows executable crashes at initialization for all eight selections and the previous bottom6 control. Relinking unchanged objects with a 256MiB stack does not repair the control. These raw failures are retained and do not prove a new physical boundary defect or qualify equivalence.
qualification_selection.storage: No new large local campaign below shared-policy capacity; exact source-bound Windows/Ubuntu CI fallback may be selected after actual storage refusal. Small read-only and already-linked original diagnostic probes remain separately identified.

excluded: AGE, aquifer, active vapor, non-model1, hysteresis0/1, initialization1/3, subdaily/perstep/non-daily calendars, effective DIVD0 with CDE, unsupported examined Ksat, other lower boundaries and closed/front numerical failures.
